_comment: Read-only, project-scoped Supabase MCP server for the Northgate teaching kit. project_ref points at our own Supabase project (mvgqoktpqmjwqhwzysyb) so the instructor doesn't have to swap it in before the session. This ref alone grants no access on its own — authentication still happens per person via the browser OAuth flow (claude, then /mcp, then Authenticate). If you fork this repo for your own client data, point it at your own project instead.
